blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Counsel for the prosecution Lorna Kapunan reminded the Senate on Thursday that it was the same chamber that passed the Safe Spaces Act, after Sen. Raffy Tulfo said a member of the prosecution team was “trying to be cute” while questioning a witness in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. Kapunan said she believed Tulfo’s remark was a misstatement but stressed that the Senate should remain a safe space for women. “Let me just say that I think the Senate should be reminded that it was the Senate that passed the Safe Space Law.
